_about: Public-domain William Alfred Quayle (1860-1925), bishop of the Methodist Episcopal Church, for the Word Hoard: his religious books: The Blessed Life (1901), Eternity in the Heart (1904), God's Calendar (1907), The Book of Ruth (1910), The Pastor-Preacher (1910), Laymen in Action (1912), The Climb to God, prayers (1913), The Dynamite of God (1918), The Throne of Grace, prayers (1919), The Uncommon Commonplace (1921), The Healing Shadow (1923) and Out-of-Doors with Jesus (1924). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 78 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
